excludeDomains.description: List of domains/hostnames to exclude from ingestion (e.g. social media apps, messaging, or private sites).

excludePatterns.description: Wildcard or regex URL patterns to exclude for user privacy or collision avoidance.

excludePrivateBrowsing.description: Whether to ignore pages visited in private or incognito browsing windows.

sessionInactivityMinutes.description: Inactivity duration in minutes after which subsequent web activity begins a new session.

enableLlmAnalysis.description: Whether to analyze web pages using an LLM to generate summaries, topics, and classifications.

generateSessionSummaries.description: Whether to synthesize web activity within a single browsing session into a cohesive narrative.

extractTopics.description: Whether to extract key concept and topic nodes from web content for the knowledge graph.

minContentLength.description: Minimum character length of extracted page body text required to trigger LLM analysis.

maxContentChars.description: Maximum character length of content excerpt passed to the LLM prompt.

chunkSize.description: Target character size for text chunks stored in the vector and full-text search index.

llmModel.description: Optional model override for chat completion analysis (defaults to host OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL).

namespace.description: Knowledge graph namespace for generated entities and edges.
